UI_trait_VargursVampires_VampireDesc:
Improved health regeneration.
Can eat meat, raw meat, and blood.
Lowered rate of corpse sickness.
Sunlight burns exposed skin.
Non-meat does not provide sustenance and will make you ill.
UI_trait_VargursVampires_SunResistantDes: Reduces incoming sunlight UV by 20 percent and applies an additional 20 percent reduction to sun damage.
UI_VargursVampires_BloodExtraction_Reaso: Requires an intact corpse away from fire.
Blood has already been extracted from this corpse.
This corpse has no blood remaining.
You are too full to drink.
Requires a corpse no more than two hours old.
Cannot use a corpse while dead or inside a vehicle.
Requires a sharp knife in working condition.
Requires an unsealed, refillable fluid container in your inventory.
The container must be empty or contain only the same type of blood.
